name: Qwen
description: Alibaba Cloud's Qwen model family, accessed through the Qwen Studio consumer app (chat.qwen.ai). The GA flagship is Qwen3.5 (released 2026-02-17, Apache-2.0 open weights) — a natively multimodal, early-fusion model with built-in image generation and the Qwen3.5-Omni real-time voice variant; Qwen3.7 (announced 2026-05-20) is a newer API-only preview. Strong multilingual support (~201 languages in text), long context up to 1M tokens, and agentic tool use.

writing-chat.summary: Qwen Studio (chat.qwen.ai, rebranded from Qwen Chat) provides a web-based chat experience powered by the natively multimodal Qwen3.5, with strong multilingual text generation across ~201 languages and an extended-thinking reasoning mode.

subFeatures.name: Qwen Studio
subFeatures.description: Web-based conversational interface (formerly 'Qwen Chat', now Qwen Studio at chat.qwen.ai) with multi-turn dialogue, markdown rendering, and code highlighting

subFeatures.name: Multilingual Coverage (~201 languages)
subFeatures.description: Strong performance across Chinese, English, and roughly 201 languages in text via native multilingual training

subFeatures.name: Open and Hosted Variants
subFeatures.description: Qwen3.5-397B-A17B open weights (Apache-2.0), Qwen3.5-Plus hosted with 1M-token context and built-in tools, plus on-device Qwen3.5-Small models

subFeatures.name: Extended Thinking Mode
subFeatures.description: Step-by-step reasoning mode for complex math, logic, and analysis, built into the Qwen3.5/Qwen3.7 line

limitations: Web chat interface less polished than ChatGPT or Claude
Performance on lower-resource languages varies
Qwen3.7 is preview/API-only with no open weights yet (as of May 2026)
Naming iterates quickly across Qwen3.5/3.6/3.7 releases

pricingTiers.details: Free access to Qwen3.5 in Qwen Studio, including image generation, voice, and file analysis (rate limits at peak)
Qwen3.7-Max preview at $2.50/M input, $7.50/M output tokens; Qwen3.5-Plus pricing via Alibaba Cloud Model Studio
Qwen3.5-397B-A17B open weights under Apache-2.0 for local deployment (Qwen3.7 currently closed-weights)

versionHistory.changes: Preview/API-only (announced 2026-05-20): Qwen3.7-Max (text, 1M context, extended thinking) and Qwen3.7-Plus (multimodal); closed weights
GA flagship (2026-02-17): natively multimodal early-fusion model, Apache-2.0 open weights, ~201 languages
Real-time speech in/out with 113-language speech recognition added to the Qwen3.5 line
Prior generation (now two generations behind), separate VL/Audio models

research.summary: Qwen Studio includes web search for finding current information, with Qwen3.5/Qwen3.7 extended-thinking reasoning providing deep analytical capabilities for complex research questions.

subFeatures.name: Web Search
subFeatures.description: Search the web from within Qwen Studio to find current information and provide cited responses

subFeatures.name: Reasoning-Based Analysis
subFeatures.description: Qwen3.5/Qwen3.7 extended-thinking mode provides deep analytical reasoning for complex research questions requiring multi-step logic

limitations: Web search less comprehensive than Perplexity or ChatGPT
No autonomous multi-step research agent
Search results may favor Chinese-language sources
No dedicated research report generation feature

pricingTiers.details: Web search included in free chat
No built-in web search in API

versionHistory.changes: Web search integration in the Qwen consumer app

file-analysis.summary: Qwen3.5 is natively multimodal (early-fusion vision-language from pre-training), analyzing images, documents, and video directly in Qwen Studio without separate VL models, with strong OCR especially for Chinese text.

subFeatures.name: Native Image Analysis
subFeatures.description: Analyze images including documents, screenshots, diagrams, and photographs directly with the natively multimodal Qwen3.5 model (no separate Qwen-VL model required)

subFeatures.name: Document OCR
subFeatures.description: Strong optical character recognition especially for Chinese and English documents, handwriting, and mixed-language content

subFeatures.name: Video Understanding
subFeatures.description: Analyze video content with Qwen3.5's unified vision-language understanding, extracting information from video frames

limitations: File upload capabilities vary by interface (Qwen Studio vs API)
No sandboxed code execution for data analysis
Spreadsheet analysis limited to visual/OCR approach
Largest multimodal quality on hosted Qwen3.5-Plus rather than smallest on-device models

pricingTiers.details: Image and document upload in Qwen Studio
Multimodal input at standard token pricing via DashScope
Qwen3.5 open-weight models (Apache-2.0) for local multimodal deployment

versionHistory.changes: Natively multimodal (early-fusion) vision-language replaces the separate Qwen-VL line
Prior-generation separate vision-language model with video understanding

document-creation.summary: Qwen generates text documents, technical content, and structured output through its chat interface, with particular strength in bilingual Chinese-English content creation.

subFeatures.name: Bilingual Document Generation
subFeatures.description: Generate high-quality documents in both Chinese and English, including translations and bilingual content

subFeatures.name: Technical Content Creation
subFeatures.description: Produce technical reports, code documentation, and structured content with mathematical notation support

limitations: No dedicated document editor or workspace
No export to Word, PDF, or other formats
No collaborative editing features
Output limited to text formats

pricingTiers.details: Full text generation in chat
Structured output and JSON mode via DashScope API

versionHistory.changes: Improved long-form document generation

image-generation.summary: Qwen Studio now includes built-in image generation and editing for free, a first-class consumer feature in the Qwen3.5 era (it was not a polished consumer feature in the Qwen2.5 era).

subFeatures.name: Image Generation in Qwen Studio
subFeatures.description: Generate images from text prompts directly inside Qwen Studio (chat.qwen.ai) as a built-in, free feature

subFeatures.name: Image Editing
subFeatures.description: Edit and iterate on images within Qwen Studio's conversational interface

limitations: Rate limits may apply at peak times on the free tier
Fine-grained composition and layout controls are limited
Quality varies by prompt and style relative to dedicated image models

pricingTiers.details: Image generation and editing included free in Qwen Studio
Image generation also available via Alibaba Cloud Model Studio / DashScope

versionHistory.changes: Free built-in image generation and editing added to the consumer app

prototyping.summary: Qwen provides strong code generation and ships qwen-code, a terminal coding agent. Qwen3.5/Qwen3.7 are positioned as native multimodal agents, with a 1M-token context for working across large codebases.

subFeatures.name: Code Generation
subFeatures.description: Generate code in multiple languages with the Qwen3.5/Qwen3.7 models, strong on coding benchmarks

subFeatures.name: qwen-code Terminal Agent
subFeatures.description: qwen-code is a terminal-based coding agent from the Qwen team for agentic, multi-step software tasks

subFeatures.name: Long Context Coding
subFeatures.description: Up to 1M-token context (Qwen3.5-Plus / Qwen3.7-Max) enables working with entire large codebases in a single session

limitations: No sandboxed code execution environment in the chat app
No live preview or interactive code runner in Qwen Studio
IDE integration limited to API-based extensions and qwen-code
Local deployment of full models requires significant GPU resources

pricingTiers.details: Code generation in Qwen Studio
Code generation via DashScope (Qwen3.5-Plus / Qwen3.7-Max)
Qwen3.5 open weights (Apache-2.0) for local coding assistance

versionHistory.changes: Terminal coding agent launched alongside the Qwen3.5/3.7 agent push
Native multimodal model with strong agentic coding
Prior-generation top open-source coding model

personalization.summary: Qwen Studio has minimal personalization features. API users can set system prompts, but the consumer app lacks custom instructions, memory, or preference systems.

subFeatures.name: System Prompts (API)
subFeatures.description: API users can configure system prompts to customize model behavior for specific use cases

limitations: No custom instructions in web interface
No memory or persistent preferences
No custom bot or persona creation in chat
Personalization only available through API system prompts

pricingTiers.details: No personalization features
System prompts for behavior customization

versionHistory.changes: Improved system prompt following in API

persistent-context.summary: Qwen maintains conversation history in its web interface and offers extremely long context windows (up to 1M tokens) that allow maintaining extensive in-session context.

subFeatures.name: Conversation History
subFeatures.description: Saved conversations accessible in the web interface for review and continuation

subFeatures.name: Ultra-Long Context (1M Tokens)
subFeatures.description: Hosted Qwen3.5-Plus (and Qwen3.7-Max) support up to 1M tokens of context, enabling analysis of entire books, codebases, or document collections in a single session

limitations: No cross-session memory system
No knowledge base uploads for persistent context
1M context delivered via hosted Qwen3.5-Plus / Qwen3.7-Max
No project or workspace organization

pricingTiers.details: Conversation history with standard context
Up to 1M token context via Alibaba Cloud Model Studio

versionHistory.changes: 1M-token context on the hosted Qwen3.5-Plus model
Prior-generation 1M-token context variant

agents.summary: Qwen3.5 and Qwen3.7 are explicitly positioned as native multimodal agents. Qwen3.7-Max demonstrated long-horizon autonomous runs (a 35-hour session with 1,158 tool calls), and qwen-code plus the Qwen-Agent framework support building autonomous agents via API.

subFeatures.name: Native Multimodal Agents
subFeatures.description: Qwen3.5/Qwen3.7 are designed as native multimodal agents; Qwen3.7-Max demonstrated a 35-hour autonomous run with 1,158 tool calls

subFeatures.name: qwen-code & Qwen-Agent
subFeatures.description: qwen-code terminal agent and the open-source Qwen-Agent framework for building autonomous agents with tool use, planning, and memory

subFeatures.name: Function Calling (API)
subFeatures.description: Native function calling and tool use in the Qwen API, enabling agents to interact with external systems

limitations: No built-in autonomous agent runner in the Qwen Studio chat interface
No browser automation in the chat app itself
Programmatic agent building requires the API or external frameworks
Qwen3.7 agent capabilities are preview/API-only as of May 2026

pricingTiers.details: No built-in agent runner in the chat app
Function calling and agentic models (Qwen3.5-Plus / Qwen3.7-Max) at DashScope pricing
Open-weight Qwen3.5 models for custom agent deployment

versionHistory.changes: Demonstrated 35-hour autonomous operation with 1,158 tool calls (preview)
Terminal coding agent released
Open-source agent framework released

connectors.summary: Qwen connects to external systems through Alibaba Cloud's DashScope API (compatible with OpenAI format) and is available across major open-source platforms including Hugging Face, Ollama, and vLLM.

subFeatures.name: DashScope API
subFeatures.description: Alibaba Cloud's model serving platform with OpenAI-compatible API format for easy integration into existing applications

subFeatures.name: Open-Source Platform Availability
subFeatures.description: Available on Hugging Face, Ollama, vLLM, and other inference platforms for flexible deployment and integration

limitations: No native third-party integrations in web interface
No plugin or extension ecosystem in Qwen Studio
No direct Google Drive, Slack, or productivity tool connectors
DashScope API primarily targets Alibaba Cloud ecosystem

pricingTiers.details: OpenAI-compatible API through Alibaba Cloud
Free open-source weights with self-hosted infrastructure

versionHistory.changes: DashScope API with OpenAI format compatibility
Qwen3.5-397B-A17B released on Hugging Face/ModelScope under Apache-2.0

dictation.summary: Qwen3.5-Omni makes voice a first-class consumer feature in Qwen Studio: real-time speech in/out, voice control, and voice cloning, with 113-language speech recognition and 36-language synthesis.

subFeatures.name: Real-Time Voice (Qwen3.5-Omni)

subFeatures.name: Multilingual Speech Recognition
subFeatures.description: Speech recognition across 113 languages and dialects, with synthesis across 36 languages

limitations: Voice cloning and real-time modes may be subject to rate limits at peak
Synthesis covers fewer languages (36) than recognition (113)
Voice quality varies by device and connection

pricingTiers.details: Real-time voice in/out included in the consumer app
Qwen3.5-Omni speech available through Alibaba Cloud Model Studio / DashScope

versionHistory.changes: Real-time speech in/out, voice control and cloning; 113-language recognition, 36-language synthesis
Prior-generation audio-language research model
